4	def mean(xs):

10	    if not xs:
11	        raise ValueError("median of empty sequence")

13	    n = len(s)
14	    mid = n // 2
15	    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2 if n % 2 == 0 else s[mid]

17	def percentile(xs, p):
18	    if not xs:
19	        raise ValueError("percentile of empty sequence")
20	    if not 0 <= p <= 100:
21	        raise ValueError("p must be in [0, 100]")
22	    s = sorted(xs)
23	    if len(s) == 1:
24	        return s[0]
25	    k = (len(s) - 1) * p / 100
26	    f = math.floor(k)
27	    c = math.ceil(k)
28	    return s[f] + (s[c] - s[f]) * (k - f)

31	    if len(xs) < 2:
